situations.title: 라텍스 알레르기 문진
situations.tagline: I break out in hives whenever I touch rubber gloves — does that count as an allergy?
situations.brief: 환자의 라텍스 알레르기 여부를 문진으로 확인하고 반응 양상을 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me what happens when you touch latex.
That definitely counts, and it's important we know.
I'll flag your chart as a latex allergy.

situations.title: 라텍스 프리 환경 준비
situations.tagline: This one's a latex allergy — let's set up the room latex-free before anything comes in.
situations.brief: 라텍스 알레르기 환자를 위해 수술방을 latex-free 환경으로 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's stock only latex-free supplies in here.
I'll double-check the cart before we start.
Everyone entering needs to know it's a latex case.

situations.title: 라텍스 프리 장갑 사용
situations.tagline: Grab the nitrile gloves for this case — no latex on the field at all.
situations.brief: 라텍스 프리 대체 장갑을 준비해 수술팀 전체가 사용하도록 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: These are nitrile, latex-free gloves.
Make sure every glove box in here is latex-free.
I'll pull any latex gloves off the field.

situations.title: 라텍스 함유 물품 파악
situations.tagline: Let's go through the tray — I want to know which of these still have latex in them.
situations.brief: 수술에 쓰일 물품 중 라텍스 함유 여부를 하나씩 확인해 걸러내세요.
keyPhrases: Check the packaging for latex content.
This tourniquet is latex — let's swap it out.
I'll set aside anything we're unsure about.

situations.title: 알레르기 경고 표지
situations.tagline: Let's post the latex allergy sign on the door so nobody brings latex in by mistake.
situations.brief: 라텍스 알레르기 경고 표지를 부착해 팀 전체가 인지하도록 하세요.
keyPhrases: The latex allergy sign goes on the door.
This alerts anyone coming in to the room.
I'll also note it on the whiteboard.

situations.title: 아침 첫 케이스 배정
situations.tagline: They told me I'm scheduled first thing in the morning — is that because of my latex allergy?
situations.brief: 라텍스 알레르기 환자를 아침 첫 수술로 배정하는 이유를 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Being first lowers latex particles in the air.
The room is cleanest at the start of the day.
This is an extra step to keep you safe.

situations.title: 과일 교차반응 식품력
situations.tagline: Now that you mention it, bananas and avocado make my mouth itch — is that related?
situations.brief: 라텍스-과일 교차반응 가능성을 식품력으로 사정해 알레르기 위험을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Banana and avocado can cross-react with latex.
Tell me about any other foods that bother you.
This helps us gauge your latex allergy risk.

situations.title: 라텍스 함유 기구 대체
situations.tagline: The catheter and drain in this pack are latex — I'm pulling latex-free replacements now.
situations.brief: 라텍스 함유 기구를 확인하고 대체 물품을 확보해 수술 준비를 완료하세요.
keyPhrases: This drain contains latex, so we can't use it.
I've got a silicone alternative ready.
Let me confirm every item on the field is latex-free.
goals: 라텍스 함유 기구를 대체 물품으로 교체한다
수술 필드의 라텍스 프리를 최종 확인한다

situations.title: 이전 라텍스 반응 병력
situations.tagline: Last time in the hospital I had a scary reaction — my throat felt tight after they examined me.
situations.brief: 환자의 이전 라텍스 반응 병력을 상세히 사정해 중증도를 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me exactly what happened last time.
Did you need any emergency treatment for that?
A throat reaction is serious — we'll take extra care.

situations.title: 팀 라텍스 프리 공지
situations.tagline: Before we bring the patient in, everyone needs to hear this is a strict latex-free case.
situations.brief: 수술팀 전원에게 라텍스 프리 케이스임을 명확히 공지하고 확인을 받으세요.
keyPhrases: This is a latex-free case for everyone in the room.
Please check your gloves and supplies before entering.
Speak up if you spot anything with latex.
goals: 팀 전원에게 라텍스 프리 케이스를 공지한다

situations.title: 약병 고무마개 위험
situations.tagline: Watch that vial — the rubber stopper has latex, so let's draw up differently for this patient.
situations.brief: 약병 고무마개의 라텍스 위험을 인지하고 안전한 약물 준비 방법을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: That stopper contains latex — don't spike it.
Let's use a latex-free vial or remove the stopper.
I'll double-check every medication we draw up.

situations.title: 지혈대·튜브 라텍스 확인
situations.tagline: Check the tourniquet and the IV tubing ports — some of these still have latex in them.
situations.brief: 지혈대와 튜브 등 부속품의 라텍스 함유 여부를 확인해 교체하세요.
keyPhrases: This tourniquet is latex — swap it for silicone.
Check the injection ports on the tubing too.
I'll verify each accessory is latex-free.

situations.title: 라텍스 분진 공기 노출
situations.tagline: Powdered latex gloves were just used next door — let's air the room out before the patient comes in.
situations.brief: 공기 중 라텍스 분진 노출을 줄이기 위한 환기와 시간 조치를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Airborne latex particles can trigger a reaction.
Let's let the room ventilate before we start.
No powdered latex gloves anywhere near this case.
goals: 공기 중 라텍스 분진 노출을 인지한다

situations.title: 척수이분증 고위험 선별
situations.tagline: My daughter has spina bifida — I read that puts her at high risk for a latex allergy. Is that true?
situations.brief: 척수이분증 소아의 라텍스 알레르기 고위험을 선별하고 보호자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, spina bifida raises her latex allergy risk.
We'll treat her as high risk and go latex-free.
We're taking every precaution to keep her safe.

situations.title: 노출 초기 증상 감시
situations.tagline: Keep an eye on her skin and airway — if she was exposed, the first signs can show up fast.
situations.brief: 라텍스 노출 후 초기 증상을 면밀히 감시해 조기에 반응을 포착하세요.
keyPhrases: Watch for flushing, hives, or wheezing.
Any drop in pressure could be an early reaction.
Tell me immediately if you see any change.

situations.title: 라텍스 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: She's flushed, wheezing, and her pressure's tanking — this is anaphylaxis, get me epinephrine.
situations.brief: 라텍스로 인한 아나필락시스를 즉시 인지하고 응급 처치를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Epinephrine is drawn up and ready.
I'm opening fluids wide and calling for help.
Removing all latex from the field now.

situations.title: 원인 미상 술중 반응
situations.tagline: She's reacting and I don't know why — let's rule out latex before we blame the drugs.
situations.brief: 원인 미상의 술중 반응에서 라텍스를 감별해 노출원을 배제하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check what latex she may have contacted.
Hold any new medications while we investigate.
I'll pull all latex items off the field.

situations.title: 노출원 즉시 제거
situations.tagline: Latex gloves are still on the field — strip them off and reglove everyone right now.
situations.brief: 라텍스 반응의 노출원을 즉시 찾아 제거하고 필드를 정화하세요.
keyPhrases: Remove every latex item from the field now.
Everyone re-glove with latex-free gloves.
Wipe down anything that touched latex.

situations.title: 순환 허탈 epinephrine
situations.tagline: Her pressure's bottoming out — I need epinephrine and a fluid bolus wide open, now.
situations.brief: 라텍스 반응으로 인한 순환 허탈에 epinephrine 투여를 신속히 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Epinephrine is ready — tell me the dose.
Fluids are wide open through the large-bore line.
I'm cycling the blood pressure every minute.

situations.title: 기관지 경련 대응
situations.tagline: She's tight and I can barely ventilate — bronchospasm from the latex, get me a bronchodilator.
situations.brief: 라텍스 반응으로 인한 기관지 경련을 인지하고 기도 처치를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get the bronchodilator ready now.
Increasing oxygen to one hundred percent.
Epinephrine is standing by if she worsens.
goals: 기관지 경련을 인지하고 기도 처치를 지원한다

situations.title: 반복 노출 재발 방지
situations.tagline: She reacted once already — let's make sure nothing latex touches her for the rest of this case.
situations.brief: 라텍스 반응 후 재노출을 차단해 반응 재발을 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: Every item from here on must be latex-free.
Let's document her reaction in the record.
Keep watching her for any recurrence.
